title: DSB-SC Modulation & coherent demodulation
aim: Construct a DSB-SC transmitter and coherent receiver, compare signals, and diagnose a controlled carrier mismatch.
predictionPrompt: Predict the original, DSB-SC and recovered waveforms before running; predict how a relative 90-degree receiver phase fault changes recovery.

observationPrompts.en: Record baseline message and carrier frequencies and compare recovered amplitude after startup.
observationPrompts.or: Baseline Message ଓ Carrier frequency ଲେଖନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ Startup ପରେ Recovered amplitude ତୁଳନା କରନ୍ତୁ।

observationPrompts.en: Record the relative receiver phase, recovery change, and why the correction works.
observationPrompts.or: Relative Receiver phase, Recovery ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ ଓ Correction କାହିଁକି କାମ କରେ ଲେଖନ୍ତୁ।

why.en: Pointer targets must belong to this experiment.
why.or: Pointer target ଏହି experiment ର ହେବା ଦରକାର।

checkpoints.expected: Confirm the selected experiment and saved model reference before pointing.

instruction.en: Place the Message and Carrier sources

why.en: Separate sources make the information and reference visible.
why.or: ଅଲଗା Source ତଥ୍ୟ ଓ Reference କୁ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ କରେ।

checkpoints.expected: Message and Carrier Sine Wave blocks are present.

instruction.en: Set source frequencies, amplitudes and phases
instruction.or: Source ର Frequency, Amplitude ଓ Phase ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ

why.en: The time-based source uses rad/s; pi/2 makes its sine output a cosine.
why.or: Time-based source rad/s ବ୍ୟବହାର କରେ; pi/2 Phase ଦେଲେ Sine output Cosine ହୁଏ।

checkpoints.expected: Message: amplitude 1, 2*pi*100 rad/s, phase 0; Carrier: amplitude 1, 2*pi*2000 rad/s, phase pi/2; both bias 0.

why.or: ଗୁଣ କଲେ DSB-SC Signal ତିଆରି ହୁଏ।

checkpoints.expected: Message and Carrier connect to distinct Product inputs; no DC carrier offset is added.

instruction.en: Build the local carrier and receiver Product
instruction.or: Local carrier ଓ Receiver Product ତିଆରି କରନ୍ତୁ

why.en: Matching the local carrier permits coherent recovery.
why.or: Local Carrier ମେଳିଲେ Coherent recovery ସମ୍ଭବ।

checkpoints.expected: Local carrier matches amplitude 1, 2*pi*2000 rad/s and phase pi/2; modulated signal and local carrier enter receiver Product.

checkpoints.targetLabel: Lowpass Transfer Fcn and Recovery Gain

instruction.en: Add the lowpass stage and Gain 2

why.en: The filter suppresses doubled-carrier products; the gain restores the product scale.
why.or: Filter doubled-carrier Product କମାଏ; Gain Product scale ସୁଧାରେ।

checkpoints.expected: Transfer Fcn coefficients match the specified second-order 500 Hz Butterworth filter; following Gain is 2.

instruction.en: Connect and label the observation scopes

why.en: Side-by-side traces allow meaningful comparisons without changing the model.
why.or: ପାଖାପାଖି Trace ରୁ Model ନବଦଳାଇ ତୁଳନା କରିହେବ।

checkpoints.expected: Scopes show sources, modulated output, and original versus recovered message on separate input ports.

instruction.en: Set simulation duration and maximum step
instruction.or: Simulation duration ଓ Maximum step ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ

why.en: A bounded step resolves the fast carrier and the short run keeps the lab responsive.
why.or: ଛୋଟ Step ରୁ ଦ୍ରୁତ Carrier ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ହୁଏ; ଛୋଟ Run lab କୁ ସହଜ ରଖେ।

checkpoints.expected: StopTime 0.1 s, variable-step ode45, MaxStep 1e-5 s.

why.en: A completed run is needed before interpreting its output.
why.or: Output ବୁଝିବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ Run ସଫଳ ହେବା ଦରକାର।

checkpoints.expected: The selected model completes a run without an error; evidence records the current parameter version.

why.en: A finite filter can delay the trace; exact pixel equality is not the criterion.
why.or: Finite Filter Trace କୁ ପଛକୁ ନେଇପାରେ; ନିଖୁତ Pixel equality ମାନଦଣ୍ଡ ନୁହେଁ।

checkpoints.expected: After startup, recovered message is near 100 Hz and unit amplitude, with predicted filter phase lag and small residual ripple.

why.en: Only the receiver changes, isolating the effect of relative phase.
why.or: କେବଳ Receiver ବଦଳିବାରୁ relative Phase ର ପ୍ରଭାବ ଅଲଗା ଭାବରେ ବୁଝିହେବ।

checkpoints.expected: Student sets Local carrier Phase to pi, reruns, and observes suppression of the message component with possible high-frequency residual.

checkpoints.targetLabel: Local carrier, Run, Save and Kiki observations

instruction.or: ପୂର୍ବ Setting ଫେରାଇ, ପୁଣି ଚଲାଇ, Save କରି ବୁଝାନ୍ତୁ

why.en: Restoration and explanation demonstrate an understood correction rather than a guessed change.
why.or: Setting ଫେରାଇବା ଓ ବୁଝାଇବାରୁ Correction ବୁଝିଛନ୍ତି କି ନାହିଁ ଜଣାପଡ଼େ।

checkpoints.expected: Local carrier Phase returns to pi/2; verified rerun restores recovery; model saved externally; student explains carrier alignment.
